label: Bible Study
prompt: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with _____.
verse: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
note: The room shook after they prayed — and they went right on preaching boldly.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jonathan said to David, Go in _____, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verse: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
note: Jonathan's goodbye to his best friend David: go in peace — their friendship sworn before the LORD.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Moreover the king made a great throne of _____, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verse: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
note: Solomon's great throne was ivory overlaid with the best gold — six steps up, with twelve lions standing on them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: _____ the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verse: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
note: Psalm 2's warning to rebellious kings: pay homage to God's anointed Son before his anger flares.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I _____ my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verse: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
note: Jesus' last words in Luke echo Psalm 31:5: 'into thy hands I commend my spirit.'
